findingsThatChangedTheDesign: THE THREE LENSES SIT AT THREE DIFFERENT DISTANCES FROM DATA AND THE BLOCKER AT EACH IS A DIFFERENT KIND OF THING. src/vendor-live.mjs is wired into server.mjs via REAL_LIVE_DOMAINS for all three regions, and its own header records a live verification dated 2026-09-03: Power BI returns real data; FirstDue returns a 403 because the API credential lacks apparatus/assets scope; GoTo returns goto_not_authorized because the OAuth consent flow has never been completed by a human. Parks has no vendor to grant at all. So the design spine is: the lens names what is in the way and what KIND of thing would move it, a consent, an entitlement, or a source that does not exist. This was not in the dispatch's given state and is the reason the three lenses are not three copies of one template.

THE LIVE CALL FEED IS ONE AGGREGATE RECORD, NOT A QUEUE BREAKDOWN. composeRealCallAnalytics maps a single all-queues-today summary. The demo pack draws a 5-queue by 5-day matrix that the live vendor cannot supply. A design that ships the matrix promises staff a breakdown that disappears at cutover, so the matrix board has to say so on the page.

THE TWO PATHS DISAGREE ON A RATIO. src/domains/call-analytics.mjs refuses to put an answer rate on a record (a ratio without its denominator beside it is the figure DEV_PROCESS 1.1 exists to stop); mapRealCallSummaryRecord carries answerRate straight from the vendor. One product, two paths, opposite rules. Found only by comparing the fixture domain against the live mapper.

THE REFUSAL DOES NOT SURVIVE THE CUTOVER. The generated apparatus record carries crewBasis stating no person is named. mapRealFireApparatusRecord carries no crew field and no basis for its absence, so the statement silently disappears when the feed lands.

THE SHIPPED CIP TABLE DECLARES A COLUMN THE GENERATED RECORD CANNOT FILL. web/index.html gives the capital projects table a Completion header; the fixture record has no completion field (only the live mapper does). A blank cell would read as zero percent complete.
THE RELATIVE DAY WINDOW POINTS FORWARD ON A HISTORICAL MEASURE. dayLabelFor produces today / in 1 day / in 4 days, and the call domain applies it to volumes that have already happened.

designArgument.public-works: TWO REGIONS OF DIFFERENT UNITS. Capital projects is one row per project with a constrained lifecycle: STATUS_PHASES declares which status-phase pairs cannot occur, so the second axis is a matrix with FORBIDDEN cells, and a hatched cell (cannot occur by rule) is a third state beside a zero (can occur, none present). Call analytics is one bucket per queue per relative day, and the product's two tables are two MARGINS of the same 25-bucket matrix reconciling to the same 2365, so it is drawn once as a matrix with both margins and the reconciliation printed.
designArgument.fire-ems: ONE REGION, AND THE SECOND AXIS IS A PARTITION. The domain states its own brief: a city with every out-of-service truck in one station is a different fact from a city with one in each, and a rollup cannot say which. That sentence forbids a single stacked bar and asks for small multiples, the same four-band readiness measure repeated per station.
designArgument.parks: NO AXIS, BECAUSE THERE IS NO DATA AND NO SOURCE. Parks gets no metric tiles, no table skeleton and none of the built-surface vocabulary (Not read / Region unread / has not been read for this pack), because every one of those sentences says the surface exists and is unfed. Its content is the mechanism that makes it unregistrable (assertDomainShape refuses a gatedBy that is not a catalogued adapter kind, assertCityPackShape refuses a fixtureGrant naming one, and every generated record carries the vendor id in kind, so there is no vendorless path through the seam) plus the one action that would change it, plus what Parks is NOT: the parks polygon layer in property-map-catalog.mjs is a map layer, not a department register.

adversarialReviewOfThisPlan: RISK: drawing a region switcher where the product stacks both regions is a change, not a copy. Accepted and stated on the page and in the README as a proposal, because a 16-row register stacked above a 25-bucket matrix puts the second region below the fold on a 1040px screen and the staff who live in call handling never see their page. It reuses the DS tab pattern rather than inventing a component.

RISK: naming the vendor (Power BI, GoTo, FirstDue) on a lens panel is a change. The shipped panel chip says Reporting output contract / Phone output contract / Apparatus output contract and names no vendor; vendors are named on Connections. Accepted for the blocked-state cards only, because a staff member who cannot see their page needs to know whose credential is missing, and flagged in the README for ratification.

RISK: the blocked boards could assert a live state I have not read. Mitigated by refusing to: the 2026-09-03 readings are badged as RECORDED with their date and their source file, and the count is rendered UNREAD rather than as a number. No live probe was run; no credential was used.

RISK: a check that matches nothing. Mitigated by rendering the product's own CODES on the page (domain ids, gatedBy kinds, record ids, station and queue refs, status ids) in a provenance footer, so the check has real inputs and reports a non-zero matched count per predicate.
constraintsHonored: no person named on any board
fixture data badged as fixture on the page
absent / zero / unmeasured kept apart, and the forbidden matrix cell adds a fourth: cannot occur by rule
